The row runs as one unbroken masoretic paragraph internally, framed only by the pe behind it at 37.14 and the samekh closing it at 37.28, so the tradition itself treats the demonstration (37.16-20) and its spoken interpretation (37.21-28, opened by a messenger formula with no addressee change) as a single section. Close: oshb:Ezek.37.28 carries a wide-family recognition close addressed to “the nations” rather than the strict third-person plural (this expansion sits in the wider 64-verse recognition sweep, not the strict 28-verse list) -- וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בִּהְי֧וֹת מִקְדָּשִׁ֛י בְּתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם -- with a samekh mark recorded immediately after. Both sides were weighed: the onset word-event at 37.15 is one of only 39 strict-form verses in the book, corroborated behind it by the pe at 37.14, and the samekh-marked recognition close at 37.28 is corroborated from the close side before the next word-event opens the following unit at oshb:Ezek.38.1.

Two utterance-formula closes fall mid-unit at oshb:Ezek.38.18 and oshb:Ezek.38.21; both are paragraph-final rather than row-final because no fresh onset of the tracked classes follows either one, and the catastrophe description runs on without interruption. Close: the strict recognition formula closes the whole chapter at oshb:Ezek.38.23 וְהִתְגַּדִּלְתִּי֙ וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתִּ֔י וְנ֣וֹדַעְתִּ֔י לְעֵינֵ֖י גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה (sweep: 28 verses strict form), with a samekh mark recorded immediately after -- a refrain-grade close corroborated by a masoretic mark, weighed against the son-of-man sub-onset that opens the following material at oshb:Ezek.39.1.

boundary_rationale: Onset: oshb:Ezek.39.1 opens וְאַתָּ֤ה בֶן אָדָם֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א עַל גּ֔וֹג וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ גּ֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֥שֶׁךְ וְתֻבָֽל, combining the ‘and you, son of man’ sub-onset with a messenger formula and the near-verbatim ‘behold, I am against you, Gog’ verdict already given at oshb:Ezek.38.3. This sub-onset carries no word-event formula of its own -- the strict and any-form word-event sweeps both stop at 38.1 -- so 39.1 stands in the same structural class as 36.1 (both open a fresh command inside an earlier word-event's span rather than a new one). A row seam is taken here because 39.1 does carry real, present onset evidence of its own kind, and because the strict recognition formula plus samekh mark at 38.23 (behind it) already closed the preceding paragraph; the seam is not read as automatic from the chapter division alone. Close: three utterance-formula closes fall inside 39.1-10 (39.5, 39.8, 39.10); the first two are paragraph-final rather than row-final because no fresh onset follows either, and the last, oshb:Ezek.39.10 וְלֹֽא יִשְׂא֨וּ עֵצִ֜ים מִן הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְלֹ֤א יַחְטְבוּ֙ מִן הַיְּעָרִ֔ים כִּ֥י בַנֶּ֖שֶׁק יְבַֽעֲרוּ אֵ֑שׁ וְשָׁלְל֣וּ אֶת שֹׁלְלֵיהֶ֗ם וּבָֽזְזוּ֙ אֶת בֹּ֣זְזֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה, is taken as the row-final close because a samekh mark is recorded immediately after it, corroborating the text-formula evidence from the masoretic tradition as well.
